name: Pin7
title: Seven Apples at the Window
approval: Carl approved the final standalone corrected painting with four apples in the bowl and three on the cloth: We got there. Deploy @GitHub. Earlier six-apple and eight-apple attempts are not used.
processing: Crop the approved original to 900 x 1200 at (62, 180), removing its white border and excess background above and below. All seven apples remain visible. Uniform Lanczos downsampling to 300 x 400, quality-90 WebP, shared radius-26 clipping and 1% bleed. No regeneration, repainting, recolouring, or non-uniform scaling.
sourceResolutionNote: The repository source/runtime SVG embeds the 300 x 400 game export; the original and lossless 900 x 1200 crop are preserved in the supplied approval archive.
